title: Hotels with a Cologne Cathedral view: which room to book
metaDescription: Four Cologne hotels with a cathedral view room, the exact room category to book at each, and the look-alike rooms to skip.
h1: Hotels with a Cologne Cathedral view, and which room to book
dek: Four hotels around Cologne Cathedral. For each one we list the exact room category sold with the view, and the rooms that do not name it.
teaser: From a suite named for the view to a Dom Suite that the hotel's photos tie to it.

decoder.text: The Mondial Am Dom Hotel Cologne sells a Junior Suite with no view named and a Cathedral view Junior Suite. Only the second one is for this view.
The Cologne Marriott Hotel sells King Guest Rooms with no view named. Its photo gallery captions the Dom Suite as having views of Cologne Cathedral.
The Excelsior Hotel Ernst sells a Deluxe Room with no view named. Its Cathedral View Suite is the one the hotel says has a perfect view of Cologne Cathedral.

faq.q: Which Cologne hotels sell rooms with a Cologne Cathedral view?
faq.a: Of the hotels we checked in October 2026, four name a room with the cathedral in the name or the description: Excelsior Hotel Ernst, Mondial Am Dom Hotel Cologne, Cologne Marriott Hotel and Dorint Hotel at Heumarkt Cologne. Each one's own site names the room.

faq.q: Does a Cathedral view room always face the cathedral?
faq.a: The hotels name these rooms on their own sites, but they do not say which floor or side of the building each room faces. Ask the hotel which room faces the cathedral when you book.

faq.q: Is a Dom Suite the same as a Cathedral View Suite?
faq.a: Dom is the German word for cathedral. The Cologne Marriott Hotel's photo gallery captions its Dom Suite as having views of Cologne Cathedral. The Excelsior Hotel Ernst sells a suite named Cathedral View Suite. They are at different hotels.
